description: A controlled HSTU sequential recommendation baseline for four Amazon categories: Movies_and_TV, Industrial_and_Scientific, Electronics, and CDs_and_Vinyl. Train one independent HSTU model per category and compare candidates using macro-average validation HR@10. The supplied content describes an experimental protocol, not a paper or a demonstrated architectural improvement.
motivation: Make improvements attributable to changes within the HSTU family while holding data splits, seeds, evaluation, and training limits fixed. Enforce consistent training and inference and prevent gains from ensembles, hidden test information, or external data.
implementation_notes: Start from the host's corrected HSTU baseline. Use preprocessing seed 0, training seed 42, at most 200 epochs, and 200 batches per epoch. Preserve all four category routes and DATA_DIR = os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR']; store artifacts under the trial directory. Read left-padded histories at the final nonpadding position, never count-1. Keep the checkpoint architecture and embedded predictor writer synchronized. Preserve ModelView compatibility through item_emb, log2feats(sequence), and predict_score(features, items). Retain DiagnosisProbe(view, device), run_full_diagnosis(train_loader), and diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis), using measured metrics and their definitions. Use only available public histories, titles, descriptions, and timestamps. Each category must load exactly one trained model/checkpoint, without independent predictor fusion. The host evaluates 200 validation users per category with 99 unique negatives and evaluation seed 42. All search training and diagnostics share a 43,200 GPU-second budget; no measured results are supplied.
pseudocode:
for each candidate configuration within the shared search budget:
    set preprocessing seed to 0 and training seed to 42
    for category in the four required categories:
        load the supplied fixed splits from GAGC_DATA_DIR
        initialize one model from the corrected HSTU baseline
        train for at most 200 epochs, using 200 batches per epoch
        preserve final-nonpadding readout for left-padded histories
        run compatible diagnostics when needed
        save one selected checkpoint beneath the trial directory
    write working/predict.py with matching architecture and category routing
    obtain the host's validation HR@10 for each category
    select configurations by the mean of the four validation HR@10 values
retain the selected configuration's four category models for held-out inference

originality.positive: Defines a disciplined, family-preserving experimental setup with explicit diagnostic and predictor compatibility requirements.
originality.negative: No new HSTU mechanism, objective, or sampling method is proposed in the supplied description.

future_potential.positive: Provides a controlled foundation for investigating HSTU architecture, loss, optimizer, and sampling improvements across distinct categories.
future_potential.negative: Performance potential remains unverified; no validation scores, ablations, or concrete improvement hypothesis are supplied.

code_difficulty.positive: The supplied corrected baseline and fixed interfaces reduce implementation scope.
code_difficulty.negative: Architecture changes require coordinated checkpoint loading, predictor generation, diagnostics, padding correctness, and four-category routing within a limited training budget.
